Measuring browser cadence…
Flight instructions & source notes

Use short bursts of thrust to control your descent. Hold Space near the pod, then lift away to draw the tether taut. Keep Space held until it attaches. The extra mass halves your thrust and the pod swings as you manoeuvre. Bring it above the surface and into orbit.

Hold Space near a fuel tank to refuel. Shoot guns to clear your route. Shooting the reactor temporarily disables the guns; repeated hits trigger a planetary countdown. Escape before it expires. Later missions reverse gravity and hide the landscape.

All six maps, sprites, lettering and sound parameters come from Kieran HJ Connell’s disassembly. This is a native JavaScript reconstruction. Collision, enemy timing and audio synthesis have remaining differences from the BBC original. There is no music sequence in the supplied source; no replacement soundtrack has been added.

Original speed uses the source’s 30 ms clock gate. Smooth cadence fits whole game frames to browser refreshes; the speed difference is shown above. Browser refresh is an estimate, and original machine workload could lengthen a tick.
